messages:
jamie: FYI rolling out a new Dedicated GPU SKU and two region additions today.

jamie: TL;DR: NVIDIA L40S (48GB, int8-optimized) is now available as a Dedicated SKU in eu-north-1 and ca-central-1. H100 inventory increased in sa-east-1 as a limited warm pool for burst workloads. Internal KB with perf/price: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/l40s-launch

ops-bot: [system] Inventory update: L40S-eu-north-1: 10 units, L40S-ca-central-1: 8 units, H100-sa-east-1 (warm): 6 units. Live counts: /dedicated/inventory

rachel: What's the sweet spot for L40S vs H100/GH200?

jamie: L40S is optimized cost-per-token for int8 workloads and medium-context models (<=8k). H100/GH200 still best for very large contexts or high precision. See perf matrix in the KB.

omar: Any new routing rules or deterministic fallbacks we should be aware of?

jamie: Added a "gpu_tier" routing policy: preferred chain L40S -> H100 -> A100. We also added an option to hard-pin routes for SLA-critical endpoints.

kirti: How should teams validate scheduling for L40S in Dedicated zones?

jamie: Quick CLI check:
```
rw dedicated check-capacity --region eu-north-1 --gpu L40S --model ./models/medcontext-7b
```
Returns AVAILABLE or FALLBACK. Console Blueprints updated with L40S profiles.

sales: Pricing note for Sales: L40S reserved multiplier is 1.35x vs A100 baseline. Warm H100 burst pricing unchanged. Full pricing examples in KB; please sync with finance before customer outreach.

omar: Any quota or contractual caveats for existing Dedicated customers?

jamie: Existing Dedicated customers may request L40S via the capacity-change flow; approvals subject to commit size. Warm H100 is burst-only until inventory grows. Support link in KB.

ops-bot: [system] L40S test cluster provisioning enabled. Request via /ops request l40s-test {team: <team-name>} (up to 2 seats per team).

rachel: Great, booking a slot to run our medium-context summarizer. Thanks!

jamie: Thanks all 44d I'll post a short external changelog blurb after legal review and attach perf snapshots to the KB.
